BL-1439 — Five hardening gates deferred on 2026-08-19 (Stryker mutation on BL-620's, BL-955's and BL-954's file sets, mutation on pipelineBoard.ts and a stalled gherkin-mutation on BL-956's feature) still sit in backlog/hardening-debt-ledger.yaml, whose only verb is --defer, with every parcel closed; the standing-red register reads them as unowned reds and BL-1429 has throttled intake to a cap of one; the owed gates are run and recorded, the ledger gains a discharge verb, and discharged rows leave the register
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-05 by the specifier on the coordinator's note (verbatim in
description). The register rows giving this debt an owner were written
the same commit, at the head of the register file among its comments
rather than at its foot, so a parcel deleting the last data row never
conflicts with …
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options, but one consequence is yours to weigh. T…
BL-1439 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1439" (or "reject BL-1439 <reason>") to act.
